summary_1line: Duryodhana secretly orders Purochana to build a flammable palace at Varanavata to burn the Pandavas, who depart amid sorrowful farewells from citizens.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana grips Purochana’s hand in a private chamber, whispering the plan to build a palace of lac and burn the Pandavas within.
The Pandavas mount their chariots while touching the feet of Bhishma, Dhritarashtra, and the elders, as grieving citizens gather around.
Crowds of distressed citizens follow the departing Pandavas out of the city, raising their hands in protest and sorrow.
